question.problem:
Given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{8{x}^{4}},\, & x\ge \frac{1}{2} \\ 0,\, & x<\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

its cumulative distribution function is 

$$
F(x)={\begin{aligned}0,\, & x<\frac{1}{2} \\ h(x),\, & x\ge \frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the function $h(x).$
question.worked_solution:
Since our random variable $X$ has a probability distribution function $f(x)$ that is strictly positive only for $x\ge \frac{1}{2},$ the cumulative distribution function takes the following form:

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x)={\begin{aligned}0, & x<\frac{1}{2} \\ {\int }_{\frac{1}{2}}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t, & x\ge \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

For the given probability density function, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\frac{1}{2}}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{\frac{1}{2}}^{x}\frac{3}{8{t}^{4}}\,\text{d}t \\ \text{ } & ={-\frac{1}{8{t}^{3}}|}_{\frac{1}{2}}^{x} \\  & =-\frac{1}{8{x}^{3}}+1 \\  & =1-\frac{1}{8{x}^{3}}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the cumulative distribution function is given by

$$
F(x)={\begin{aligned}0, & x<\frac{1}{2}, \\ 1-\frac{1}{8{x}^{3}}, & x\ge \frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
